operator_io_quirks: All identifiers lowercase, no spaces; still double-quote in generated SQL.
status has NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op, drop_unique_duplicates no-op.
weather has NO primary key and no unique columns; only PK/unique filtering is on station.id and trip.id.
status.station_id FK -> station.id: parent has 70 rows, child 8487 rows, so FK draws are heavily duplicated (ties expected).
trip.start_station_id / end_station_id are NOT declared FKs (no pragma FK) though they reference station.id; TS treats them as plain Number columns.

Text-stored dates: station.installation_date '8/6/2013' (M/D/YYYY), trip.start_date/end_date '8/21/2015 17:03' (M/D/YYYY HH:MM), weather.date '8/29/2013', status.time '2015-06-02 12:46:02' (ISO). Declared TEXT so TS dispatches String, not Date.
weather.precipitation_inches declared INTEGER but stores 'T' (trace), '0.23' real, '0' int -> mixed storage; Number fuzzer drops non-parsable 'T'.
weather numeric columns (max_temperature_f etc.) declared INTEGER but storage includes text; zip_code in trip is integer+text.
station.lat/long NUMERIC stored as real; Number fuzzer scale from NUMERIC (no args) -> default scale, wide range.
trip.zip_code INTEGER with 475 distinct incl. leading-zero-looking 5-digit codes; Number fuzzer will perturb to non-zip values.
weather.events has empty string '' as a value (distinct 6); String fuzzer length range includes 0.
trip.start_station_name/end_station_name are denormalized duplicates of station.name (comment 'should be removed'); no FK, TS fills independently -> name/id mismatch.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE constraints anywhere; only PKs on station.id and trip.id.
operator_ts_expectations: station.id, trip.id: Number fuzzer, single-column PK -> max_l0=inf, fresh draws perturbed +-1/+-2; PK dedup keeps first occurrence.
status.station_id: FK draw from station.id final values with replacement -> many duplicate station_ids, plausible join cardinalities.
trip.start_station_id/end_station_id: plain Number, NOT tied to station.id -> joins to station on these columns mostly miss (FN/FP source).

Text date columns (installation_date, start_date, end_date, weather.date, status.time): String fuzzer -> random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, so date comparisons/strftime/date() queries get implausible values (FN).
weather numeric columns: Number fuzzer with INTEGER scale -> values in [-10,10] perturbed, far from real 30-90 ranges; range predicates (e.g. temperature > 70) mostly false (FN).
precipitation_inches: 'T' dropped as non-parsable; Number draws small ints/floats, so 'T' never reproduced (FN on trace-rain queries).

subscription_type (2 distinct), city (5), events (6): String fuzzer with p=0.2 fresh -> many random strings, so equality filters on 'Subscriber'/'Customer' mostly miss (FN); ties/duplicates from element reuse give some hits.
zip_code: Number fuzzer perturbs 5-digit codes to nearby ints, breaking exact zip equality (FN).
lat/long NUMERIC: Number scale default -> wide uniform, plausible-ish but not near real coords; distance/range queries unreliable.
No PK on status/weather: TS generates duplicate rows freely; COUNT(DISTINCT) vs COUNT queries may diverge (FP on tie-sensitive queries).
String fuzzer contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop char) on names -> near-miss strings, LIKE '%...%' queries sometimes match (FP).
Empty-string in events and String length range [0,20] -> empty strings generated, matching '' filters (some TP).
